recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片低倍（右）見紅血球緣錢狀排列（rouleaux）與藍染背景，漿細胞增多；高倍（左）見雙核、多核的異型漿細胞，以及細胞核上方有淡藍色圓形包涵體的漿細胞（Dutcher/Russell body 樣），這些都是漿細胞骨髓瘤的特徵。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Atypical binucleate and multinucleated (three- to four-lobed) plasma cells
Plasma cell with a pale blue, round, globular inclusion overlying the nucleus (Dutcher/Russell body-like)
Red cell rouleaux formation in stacked chains
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows prominent red cell rouleaux and bluish proteinaceous background staining at low power. Plasma cells are increased and include atypical binucleate and multinucleated forms. One plasma cell contains a pale, round globular inclusion overlying the nucleus, consistent with a Dutcher or Russell body. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; quantification of plasma cells and demonstration of clonality are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, polyclonal and usually <10% without multinucleation or rouleaux with blue background.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with Dutcher bodies and MYD88 L265P, rather than sheets of atypical multinucleated plasma cells.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters without a perinuclear hof, and megakaryocytes are much larger with granular cytoplasm and lobulated rather than separate nuclei.
